title: Dr. Stone
source: Dr. Stone manga by Riichiro Inagaki and Boichi (232 chapters, ended 2022), including the epilogue.
world: A mysterious green light turns every human on Earth to stone. 3,700 years later, genius Senku Ishigami breaks free and vows to rebuild civilisation from zero with science. He founds the Kingdom of Science with the villagers of Ishigami Village, fights the Stone Wars against Tsukasa's Empire of Might, and finally travels the world and to the Moon to face the Why-Man behind the petrification. Upbeat, educational adventure.
power_system: No powers. Science: Senku recreates technology step by step (fire, glass, medicine, electricity, phones, rockets). A revival fluid (nitric acid + alcohol) un-petrifies people.
